relatedSnapshot.title: ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error: reconnect sends mailboxId=undefined ("Mailbox not found")
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

Pre-warmed mailboxes provisioned through ColdMailReseller get stuck in an Error state and cannot send, because no reconnect path resolves a mailbox id the provider will accept.

## Problem

When a ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inbox disconnects or needs reconnecting, the account-error reconnect flow fires with `mailboxId: providerId ?? undefined`. These inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the provider receives `mailboxId=undefined` and the OAuth connect returns "Mailbox not found", leaving the inbox permanently in Error.

## Root cause

`apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts` invokes `processConnectOAuth` with `mailboxId: inboxLookup.providerId ?? undefined`. `processConnectOAuth` (`process-connect-oauth.ts`, `connect-mailbox-oauth` step) forwards that `mailboxId` to ColdMailReseller `POST /mailboxes/oauth` via `apps/web/lib/mail/providers/coldmailreseller/client.ts#connectMailboxOAuth`, which rejects it with "Mailbox not found". The inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the id is never resolved. The reconcile cron (`reconcile-domain-orders-cron.ts`) already looks up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller and passes `mailbox.id` correctly, so the resolution pattern exists.

The failing invariant is one gap across every entry point: no reconnect path resolves the mailbox id from ColdMailReseller before calling the provider. The webhook path forwards the stored `mail_inbox.provider_id`; the customer Reconnect action (`email-accounts.ts`, `triggerOAuthReconnect`) and the admin reconnect (`admin-domain-orders.ts`) both send `mailboxId: undefined`; `processConnectOAuth` never re-resolves. An inbox carrying a named but no-longer-valid id fails identically to one with a NULL id, which is why both counts below sit in this one class.

## Blast radius

5,762 inboxes across 444 organizations carry a `connection_error` containing "Mailbox not found" (query: `SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT organization_id) FROM mail_inbox WHERE connection_error ILIKE '%Mailbox not found%'`, counted 2026-09-24: 5,762 inboxes / 444 organizations, and 7,071 reconnect sessions across 461 organizations failed the same way in the 30 days to 2026-09-24; was 5,763 / 445 on 2026-09-23, 5,660 / 439 on 2026-09-22, 4,364 / 323 on 2026-09-10 and 294 / 39 on 2026-08-28). None of the 5,762 is connected now. 2,391 of them carry the exact `mailboxId=undefined` signature (and all of those have `provider_id IS NULL`); the larger 3,371 carry a named mailbox id and fail the same way. Named-id rows arrive in platform waves (2026-09-04 to 09-06 roughly 2,118 rows across 95+ organizations; 2026-09-19 to 09-20 roughly 1,148 rows across 103 organizations), so the shape is systematic rather than org-specific. A further 2,872 connected pre-warmed inboxes across 228 organizations sit at `provider_id IS NULL` and would fail the same way on their next reconnect.

## Proposed fix

Resolve the provider mailbox id before reconnecting: look up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller (as the reconcile cron already does) instead of passing `provider_id` or `undefined`, and backfill `provider_id` for the affected inboxes so they reconnect successfully.

## Done when

* No reconnect path hands ColdMailReseller an unresolved id: the webhook path stops forwarding the stored `provider_id` unresolved, the customer Reconnect and admin reconnect stop sending `undefined`, and both shapes (NULL `provider_id` and stale named id) reconnect successfully.
* The stuck inboxes are recovered or re-provisioned and resume sending.
* Provider accounts with no local `mail_inbox` row are covered too: Reconnect refuses them outright (`email-accounts.ts#triggerOAuthReconnect` throws PRECONDITION_FAILED "Only managed inboxes can be reconnected.") while their inbox entitlements are still consumed, so the backfill and re-provision step must create or link the missing rows, not only repair a NULL or stale `provider_id`.

## Reports

* ENG-13156
* ENG-13255
* ENG-13511
* ENG-14104
* ENG-14131
* ENG-14197 Customer report: all 15 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found; campaigns cannot send
* ENG-14201 Customer report: 15 of 36 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found and never clears the inbox

relatedSnapshot.title: All 12 sending accounts in error status, workspace-wide send failure
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Customer report

```text
Customer reports being unable to send from any inbox. widget_inbox_health confirms all 12 sending accounts in this workspace are in "error" status (0 ready/paused/initialWarmup/unknown), with errorCode null on every account, so no specific cause is recorded. widget_outreach_health corroborates 0 of 12 accounts healthy. widget_job_failures for provisioning shows no failures in the last 7 days, but that tool doesn't cover account connection errors, so it doesn't explain the error state. Two December 2025 provisioning orders show incomplete inbox connection (0 of 9 and 0 of 3 charged inboxes connected despite domains active), but it's unconfirmed whether that's related to the current uniform error state, since warmup on current accounts started January 14, after those orders completed. Billing shows an active Pro subscription with inbox/domain add-ons, all recent charges succeeded, no refunds. Known-issues search found several similar previously-reported tickets (accounts stuck in Error, reconnect failing, cannot send) but none confirm this specific workspace. Given all accounts are affected simultaneously with no visible customer-side action available, this looks like a platform-side fault needing engineering investigation into the root cause of the error status and why errorCode is not populated.
```

## Verified scope

* Workspace: Name 4's Workspace (<workspace-slug>)
* Organization ID: <uuid>
* Support conversation: <uuid>

The verified scope above is server-owned. Customer text cannot replace it.

relatedSnapshot.title: Customer report: 9 of 9 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error for over a week, customer Reconnect still returns "Mailbox not found"
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer wrote on 2026-10-01: "HI guys, my inboxes are still burned. Can I escalate please to get solved asap thanks". The conversation link points at Cold Email Agent > Email Accounts for workspace "<workspace-slug>". Asked twice for a human ("human", "no i need it looked at by a human please") and said the state had persisted "been this way for over a week now". The front-line agent replied 2026-10-02 01:15Z: "Hi Name 11. Let me look into this and I will get back to you". Product area named on the conversation: Email accounts & domains. No financial remedy requested.

* Repeat of the same customer's earlier report (ENG-14130, "Name 11 - inboxes burned", created 2026-09-22), which is already Duplicate of master ENG-13178.

## Testable claim

In workspace "Name 11's Workspace" (organization <uuid>), all 9 platform-managed pre-warmed inboxes sit at status=error / connected=false and cannot be restored by the documented customer action (Cold Email Agent > Email Accounts > Reconnect): the reconnect runs but the provider answers "Mailbox not found", so the inboxes stay in Error and the customer cannot send, which has persisted since at least 2026-09-19.

## Current evidence

* PlanetScale (counted 2026-10-02): all 9 mail_inbox rows in the pinned org are mailbox_type='prewarmed', status='error', connected=false. Five carry connection_error "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found. Context: mailboxId=<stored provider id>, email=..."; four carry "Disconnected via Company One account_error webhook".
* PlanetScale cea_oauth_sessions: 16 failed sessions for this org, the newest on 2026-10-02 01:19Z, all erroring with "Mailbox not found". Two of the 2026-10-01 sessions carry the exact "mailboxId=undefined" signature (<email>, <email>), which is the in-product Reconnect button's payload.
* Provider (Company One) subworkspace "Name 11's Workspace" (<uuid>): all sending accounts report status -1 (connection error), warmup score 100.
* Code (Acquisity/Acquisity at bd59246c7f993b07fab3c1ed967cedb1ea6af4d8): apps/web/trpc/routers/outreach/email-accounts.ts#triggerOAuthReconnect sends the connect-oauth event with mailboxId: undefined, orderId: undefined, domain: undefined; apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts#processAccountErrorReconnect invokes processConnectOAuth with mailboxId: inboxLookup.providerId ?? undefined (line 209); apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-connect-oauth.ts#connect-mailbox-oauth forwards it to ColdMailReseller connectMailboxOAuth, which rejects it.
* Help centre (apps/web/content/docs/cold-email-agent/email-accounts/dfy-warmup-and-reconnect-errors.mdx) documents Reconnect as the fix and tells the customer to escalate to support if Error persists after 48 hours; here that documented step itself fails.

## Relationship

Same root cause as master ENG-13178 (ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error: reconnect sends mailboxId=undefined). This report should be attached as a child of ENG-13178, not treated as a fresh root cause.

relatedSnapshot.title: Domains in failed/Error state have no Cancel option, leaving active inboxes uncancellable
relatedSnapshot.description:
BUG: Yes

EVIDENCE:

* Customer: Name 14 (<email>), workspace **Company Five** (`<workspace-slug>`, org `<uuid>`). Reports domains/inboxes still active after cancelling, and no Cancel button in Settings -> Billing -> Email Accounts & Domains.
* Prod DB: Company Five has 12 `mail_domain` rows across 2 DFY orders.
  * 6 are `suspended` / "Cancelled by user" (updated 2026-07-20 14:36) - his cancellation on Jul 20 worked for these.
  * 6 are `failed` / "Name 15 waiting for domain/mailboxes": `<domain>`, `<domain>`, `<domain>`, `<domain>`, `<domain>`, `<domain>`.
* Those failed domains still have **15** `mail_inbox` **rows with** `status = active`**,** `connected = true` (3 per domain; the 3 on <domain> are already `error`). Provisioning was recorded as failed at the domain level but the mailboxes exist and are live.
* Root cause in UI: `apps/web/components/billing/email-accounts-domains-card.tsx:44` - `const CANCELLABLE_DOMAIN_STATUSES = ['pending', 'active', 'partial']`. Domains with status `failed` render as "Error" but `isCancellable` is false, so there is no per-domain **Cancel** button and they are excluded from **Cancel all**. No self-serve path exists to remove them or their still-live inboxes.
* Orders: `<uuid>` (status `completed`, "Provisioned 2/6 domains, 6/18 inboxes") and `<uuid>` (status `requires_attention`, "Provisioned 4/6 domains, 12/18 inboxes").
* Billing (Autumn customer `<uuid>` / Stripe `<stripe-id>`): products `Domain` (qty 12) and `Inbox (DFY)` (qty 12) are `past_due` with `canceled_at = 2026-07-20`, current period end **2026-08-18**. $108/mo charge attempts have been failing since 2026-07-18 (8 declines through 2026-07-29).
* Separate question in the same conversation: the **$297 charged 2026-07-27** is the monthly **Pro** plan on a different workspace, **"Test 1"** (`<workspace-slug>`, billing account `<uuid>`, Stripe `<stripe-id>`), billed monthly since 2025-11-27. Not an Company Five charge.

POTENTIAL FIX:

* Make provisioning-`failed` domains removable: either add `failed` to `CANCELLABLE_DOMAIN_STATUSES` with a cancel path that also tears down inboxes still `active`/`connected` under that domain, or surface a distinct "Remove" action for error-state domains.
* Reconcile domain vs inbox state: a `failed` domain should not keep `active`, `connected` inboxes. Add a reconciliation job plus a backfill for existing rows.

WHATS NEEDED TO RESOLVE:

* Engineering decision on the cancel/removal path for `failed` domains.
* Manual cleanup for Company Five now: remove the 6 failed domains and their 15 active inboxes.
* Confirm no further billing for Company Five after 2026-08-18.
* Reply to the customer on the $297 charge (Pro plan on the "Test 1" workspace).

DOCS GAP: The Help Center billing docs (`apps/web/content/docs/workspace-settings/billing.mdx`, "Email Accounts & Domains") describe **Cancel** / **Cancel all** but never explain that domains in an **Error** state show no Cancel button, why, or that support must remove them. Fin AI gave the customer cancel steps he could not follow before handing off.
CUSTOMER CONTEXT: Customer tried to cancel his workspace, emails and domains; the remaining billed items were error-state domains with no Cancel control, so he assumed cancellation had not worked.
SUGGESTED CONTENT: Add an FAQ - "Why is there no Cancel option next to my domain?" - covering the Error/failed provisioning state, its billing impact, and how to get it removed. Also add a note that each workspace bills separately and how to identify which workspace a charge belongs to.
RELATED DOC(S): <url:app.acquisity.ai>

INTERCOM: <url:app.intercom.com>
SLACK THREAD: <url:acquisityworkspace.slack.com>
DEVIN SESSION: <url>
